propositions: The code-review tests overlay is currently triggered only by glob matches on changed file paths (**test_*.py, **/*_test.py, **/tests/**), missing changes that add product declarations without test files.
A change adding function/method/class declarations with no changed test files should trigger the tests overlay via content-based detection of added declarations in the diff.
The detector must extract declared names from added lines matching the polyglot _REMOVED_DECL_RE pattern and suppress the trigger only if those names are also removed in the same file.

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow coverage-gap findings to blocking-eligible only when the finding concerns newly-introduced behaviour (added lines in the diff) and names a concrete violating input.
The trigger must be language and layout agnostic—firing for Go func, TypeScript function, Ruby class, etc., across any directory structure, and skipping docs/data files and anonymous declarations.

The implementation adds changed_files as a keyword-only parameter to content_triggered_overlays and passes the step's changed-file list through overlay_union to enable the negative rule (no test files changed).
